verdict.rationale: cfo.ai documents that you can send investors or the board a read-only link to a report, which is scoped sharing for board reporting. Board-ready output is also supported, since Ari drafts board/investor decks off the live model. However, the evidence is a single short line and says nothing about sharing with team members under role-based or granular permissions, or about sharing live dashboards rather than reports. missing for 10: team-member sharing with role/permission scopes, link controls (expiry, revocation, per-page scoping), dashboard-level sharing, in-depth docs and independent or hands-on corroboration.
